annotations.title: Break-even usage for a subscription price

description: How many AI messages a month a subscriber can send before the model cost uses up what the plan earns, after the store or payment fee. Answers: does this plan price cover this model?

cachedTokens.description: How many of the prompt tokens are read from the prompt cache.

feePercent.description: Store or payment fee. App stores take 15 to 30; Stripe about 3.

inputTokens.description: Prompt tokens per message (system prompt and history).

messagesPerMonth.description: Optional: a user's expected messages a month, to get that user's margin.

name: subscription_break_even
